title: 鋼軌波磨研磨整治
summary: 鋼軌波磨研磨整治以「波磨波長接觸激振與材料去除量」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。鋼軌波磨把空間不平順轉成輪軌週期激振，研磨要同時保留輪廓、材料餘量與缺陷判讀，表面變亮不是品質證明。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops corrugation wavelength contact excitation and material removal through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Rail corrugation converts spatial irregularity into periodic wheel contact excitation; grinding must preserve profile, material reserve and defect interpretation, and a shiny surface is not proof of quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 波磨通過頻率與空間取樣間隔
stages.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency & Spatial sampling interval
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波磨通過頻率」與「空間取樣間隔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrugation passage frequency" and "Spatial sampling interval": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波磨通過頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波磨通過頻率」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrugation passage frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 空間波長經速度轉換為時間激振頻率。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 550 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振。使用同步速度及波長頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波磨通過頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 550 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded. Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrugation passage frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波磨通過頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrugation passage frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波磨通過頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrugation passage frequency" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長

steps.title: 波磨通過頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波磨通過頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrugation passage frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=550 Hz。模型邊界：單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=550 Hz. Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同步速度及波長頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成輪廓波長譜、同步速度及振動頻譜建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波磨通過頻率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrugation passage frequency", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local overgrinding reduces later correction reserve.

steps.title: 波磨通過頻率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波磨通過頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corrugation passage frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以同步速度及波長頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成輪廓波長譜、同步速度及振動頻譜建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「波磨通過頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic profile-wavelength spectrum, synchronous speed and vibration spectrum, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Corrugation passage frequency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「波磨通過頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長造成偏離的合成觀察，以同步速度及波長頻譜說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Corrugation passage frequency, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. Explain which evidence in synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以同步速度及波長頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成輪廓波長譜、同步速度及振動頻譜建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「波磨通過頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using synthetic profile-wavelength spectrum, synchronous speed and vibration spectrum, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Corrugation passage frequency. quiz.question: 要驗證「波磨通過頻率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrugation passage frequency"?
options: 本單元以同步速度及波長頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成輪廓波長譜、同步速度及振動頻譜建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

quiz.explanationEn: Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 波磨通過頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrugation passage frequency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波磨通過頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrugation passage frequency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長。這個失效與「波磨通過頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同步速度及波長頻譜，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. This failure and a measurement bias in Corrugation passage frequency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用同步速度及波長頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長。這個失效與「波磨通過頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同步速度及波長頻譜，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. This failure and a measurement bias in Corrugation passage frequency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation.

quiz.explanationEn: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 空間取樣間隔：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spatial sampling interval: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空間取樣間隔」如何影響鋼軌波磨研磨整治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spatial sampling interval” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail corrugation grinding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固定取樣頻率下車速越高，沿軌點距越大。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。時間取樣均勻且速度固定；未計遺失取樣及編碼器滑移。使用編碼器位置與取樣時刻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空間取樣間隔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At fixed sampling rate, faster travel increases spatial point spacing. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded. Use encoder position and acquisition time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spatial sampling interval” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz；y=v/fs*1000=10 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz; y=v/fs*1000=10 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空間取樣間隔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spatial sampling interval”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 空間取樣間隔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spatial sampling interval: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空間取樣間隔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spatial sampling interval” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz；y=v/fs*1000=10 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=11 mm。模型邊界：時間取樣均勻且速度固定；未計遺失取樣及編碼器滑移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz; y=v/fs*1000=10 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 mm. Boundary: Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以編碼器位置與取樣時刻區分模型與觀察，先用每筆時間戳、里程編碼器與相鄰點距統計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use encoder position and acquisition time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 空間取樣間隔：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「空間取樣間隔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spatial sampling interval” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以編碼器位置與取樣時刻區分模型與觀察，先用每筆時間戳、里程編碼器與相鄰點距統計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「空間取樣間隔」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use encoder position and acquisition time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using per-sample timestamps, distance encoder and adjacent-spacing statistics, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Spatial sampling interval. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「空間取樣間隔」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出時間取樣均勻且速度固定；未計遺失取樣及編碼器滑移如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨造成偏離的合成觀察，以編碼器位置與取樣時刻說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Spatial sampling interval, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation. Explain which evidence in encoder position and acquisition time distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空間取樣間隔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spatial sampling interval" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性
空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves.
Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation.
quiz.explanation: 空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
